abilities.name: Bring in the Fleshchildren
abilities.gameText: Add two minions of size equal to one die size lower than your current status.

abilities.name: Flesh of my Flesh
abilities.gameText: When one of your minions is destroyed, roll its die. You Recover that much Health.

abilities.name: Lovingly Sculpted
abilities.gameText: Boost one of your minions using Fleshcrafting and use your Max die. If it is your only minion, also Boost yourself using your Mid die. If not, Boost each of your other minions using your Min die.

abilities.name: Mold the Homunculus
abilities.gameText: Use Fleshfather to create a lieutenant of the same die size as your Max die.

abilities.name: Pound of Flesh
abilities.gameText: Whenever multiple of your minions all take the same action against the same target, you must roll all of their dice at the same time and use the lowest rolling die amongst them for each minion’s result on that action.

abilities.name: Who Can You Trust?
abilities.gameText: Replenish your Fleshchildren up to the number of heroes.
